items.stem: The committee ______ divided in their opinions on the proposal.
items.sol: committee 作“委员会成员”讲时用复数谓语（英式习惯），divided in their opinions 说明这里指人。

items.stem: The word "meticulous" is closest in meaning to ______.
items.sol: meticulous = 一丝不苟的、极其细致的，常与 attention to detail 搭配。

items.stem: Not until he failed the exam ______ the importance of hard work.
items.sol: Not until 置于句首引起部分倒装，主句用助动词提前：did he realize。

items.stem: The new regulation is subject ______ approval by the board.
items.sol: be subject to = 受……支配/须经……，to 是介词，后接名词。

items.stem: "Deteriorate" most nearly means ______.
items.sol: deteriorate = 恶化、变坏，名词形式 deterioration。

items.stem: If I ______ you, I would take the offer.
items.sol: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be 动词一律用 were。

items.stem: This is the book ______ changed my life.
items.sol: 先行词是物，关系代词用 which 或 that；what 不能引导定语从句。

items.stem: The outcome was ______: everyone had predicted it.
items.sol: inevitable = 不可避免的。

items.stem: His answer was so ______ that nobody knew what he meant.
items.sol: ambiguous = 模棱两可的。

items.stem: Whether we go ahead depends ______ the budget.
items.sol: depend on = 取决于、依赖。

items.stem: ______ the report, he submitted it to the board.
items.sol: 完成在先，用现在分词的完成式作状语。

items.stem: Only when the war ended ______ return home.
items.sol: only + 状语从句置于句首，主句用部分倒装。

items.stem: The report gives a ______ overview of the whole field.
items.sol: comprehensive = 全面的、综合的。

items.stem: The medicine helped ______ the pain.
items.sol: alleviate = 减轻（痛苦、问题）。

items.stem: ______ of cost, the plan is acceptable.
items.sol: in terms of = 就……而言。

items.stem: This view is ______ among young researchers.
items.sol: prevalent = 普遍的、流行的。

items.stem: The auditors ______ every transaction carefully.
items.sol: scrutinize = 仔细审查。

items.stem: Each of the students ______ a copy of the syllabus.
items.sol: each of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数。

items.stem: Her explanation sounds ______, but it lacks evidence.
items.sol: plausible = 看似合理的。

items.stem: Lack of sleep can ______ your ability to concentrate.
items.sol: undermine = 削弱、损害。

items.stem: The success is largely attributed ______ hard work.
items.sol: be attributed to = 归因于。

items.stem: The paragraph is ______; the same idea appears three times.
items.sol: redundant = 多余的、累赘的。

items.stem: Is it ______ to finish the project within a week?
items.sol: feasible = 可行的。

items.stem: The more you practise, ______ you become.
items.sol: the + 比较级，the + 比较级：越……越……。

items.stem: Curiosity is ______ to scientific research.
items.sol: intrinsic = 内在的、固有的。

items.stem: “meticulous” 最接近的意思是？
items.sol: meticulous = 一丝不苟的。

items.stem: “deteriorate” 的意思是？
items.sol: deteriorate = 变坏。

items.stem: “ambiguous” 的意思是？
items.sol: ambiguous = 有歧义的。

items.stem: “inevitable” 的意思是？
items.sol: in- 否定 + evitable（可避免的）。

items.stem: “substantial” 的意思是？
items.sol: substantial = 可观的、实质的。

items.stem: “compensate” 常与哪个介词搭配？
items.sol: compensate for 补偿。

items.stem: The committee ___ divided in their opinions.
items.sol: 指成员时用复数。

items.stem: Not until he failed ___ the importance of hard work.
items.sol: Not until 置句首引起部分倒装。

items.stem: The number of students ___ increasing.
items.sol: the number of 作主语用单数。

items.stem: It is high time that we ___ the problem.
items.sol: It is high time that + 过去式（虚拟）。

items.stem: He is the only one of the students who ___ passed.
items.sol: who 指 the only one，用单数。

items.stem: Hardly ___ the room when the phone rang.
items.sol: Hardly 置首用倒装 + 过去完成。

items.stem: be subject ___ approval
items.sol: be subject to 须经……。

items.stem: in spite ___ the rain
items.sol: in spite of 尽管。

items.stem: be immune ___ the disease
items.sol: be immune to 对……免疫。

items.stem: take advantage ___ the opportunity
items.sol: take advantage of 利用。

items.stem: be consistent ___ his words
items.sol: be consistent with 与……一致。

items.stem: The new policy will ______ the burden on students.
items.sol: alleviate 意为减轻；elevate 提升，allocate 分配，alienate 疏远。

items.stem: His remarks were so ______ that nobody could understand his real intention.
items.sol: ambiguous 意为模棱两可的；ambitious 有雄心的，amiable 和蔼的，amicable 友好的。

items.stem: The committee decided to ______ the meeting until next week.
items.sol: postpone 意为推迟；pose 提出，impose 强加，compose 组成。

items.stem: The scientist's theory was eventually ______ by experimental evidence.
items.sol: confirm 意为证实；confine 限制，confess 坦白，confront 面对。

items.stem: She was ______ for her outstanding contribution to education.
items.sol: commend 意为表扬；command 命令，commence 开始，commit 犯（错）。

items.stem: The government has taken measures to ______ inflation.
items.sol: curb 意为抑制；cure 治愈，curl 卷曲，cultivate 培养。

items.stem: The two countries agreed to ______ diplomatic relations.
items.sol: resume 意为恢复；assume 假定，consume 消耗，presume 推测。

items.stem: His argument is ______; it lacks sufficient evidence.
items.sol: flawed 意为有缺陷的；flushed 脸红的，flourished 繁荣的，fluctuated 波动的。

items.stem: The company was forced to ______ its workforce due to the recession.
items.sol: reduce 意为减少；deduce 推断，induce 引诱，produce 生产。

items.stem: The professor's lecture was ______ with interesting examples.
items.sol: be interspersed with 意为穿插着；interrupt 打断，interfere 干涉，intervene 干预。

items.stem: The project is ______ to be completed by June.
items.sol: be likely to do 意为可能做；possible 和 probable 不接不定式，liable 多指易于遭受。

items.stem: The manager tried to ______ the staff's concerns.
items.sol: address 意为处理、回应；dress 穿衣，access 进入，assess 评估。

items.stem: The new evidence may ______ his innocence.
items.sol: establish 意为确立、证实；install 安装，ensure 确保，insure 投保。

items.stem: The novel offers a vivid ______ of life in rural China.
items.sol: depiction 意为描绘；prediction 预测，deprivation 剥夺，deduction 推论。

items.stem: The judge found the evidence ______ and dismissed the case.
items.sol: insufficient 意为不充分的；inefficient 低效的，ineffective 无效的，inevitable 不可避免的。

items.stem: The scientist's findings ______ the existing theory.
items.sol: challenge 意为挑战、质疑；change 改变，charge 收费、指控，chase 追逐。

items.stem: She spoke with great ______ about her research.
items.sol: enthusiasm 意为热情；entitlement 权利，enterprise 企业，entrance 入口。

items.stem: The two theories are mutually ______; both cannot be true.
items.sol: mutually exclusive 意为互相排斥的；excessive 过度的，expressive 富有表现力的，expansive 广阔的。

items.stem: The company's profits have ______ sharply over the past year.
items.sol: decline 意为下降；incline 倾向，declare 宣布，decorate 装饰。

items.stem: We should not ______ the importance of teamwork.
items.sol: underestimate 意为低估；undertake 承担，undergo 经历，underlie 构成……的基础。

items.stem: The book, ______ was published last year, has become a bestseller.
items.sol: 非限制性定语从句用 which 引导，不能用 that。

items.stem: ______ he arrived home did he realize he had left his keys in the office.
items.sol: Only when 置于句首，主句用部分倒装 did he realize。

items.stem: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer.
items.sol: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be 动词统一用 were。

items.stem: The teacher demanded that the homework ______ on time.
items.sol: demand 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气 (should) be done，此处为被动。

items.stem: ______ from the top of the hill, the city looks beautiful.
items.sol: city 与 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen 作状语。

items.stem: It is important that every student ______ the rule.
items.sol: It is important that 后的主语从句用虚拟语气 (should) do，故用动词原形。

items.stem: Hardly ______ the station when the train left.
items.sol: Hardly 置于句首，主句用过去完成时部分倒装 had he reached。

items.stem: The reason ______ he was late was that he missed the bus.
items.sol: 先行词 reason 在定语从句中作原因状语，用 why 引导。

items.stem: Neither the students nor the teacher ______ aware of the change.
items.sol: neither...nor... 遵循就近原则，谓语与 teacher 一致，用 was。

items.stem: ______ more time, we could have finished the work.
items.sol: Given 意为如果给予，过去分词作条件状语，主语 we 与 give 是被动关系。

items.stem: The meeting ______ tomorrow will focus on the budget.
items.sol: 会议尚未举行且为被动，用不定式的被动式 to be held 作后置定语。

items.stem: I wish I ______ more attention to my studies last year.
items.sol: wish 后与过去事实相反，从句用过去完成时 had paid。

items.stem: She is the only one of the students who ______ the answer.
items.sol: the only one of the students 作先行词时，定语从句谓语与 one 一致，用单数 knows。

items.stem: Not until midnight ______ the work.
items.sol: Not until 置于句首，主句用部分倒装 did he finish。

items.stem: The harder you work, ______ progress you will make.
items.sol: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 表示越……越……。

items.stem: The government must ______ measures to control pollution.
items.sol: take measures 意为采取措施。

items.stem: She ______ advantage of the opportunity to study abroad.
items.sol: take advantage of 意为利用。

items.stem: He is ______ charge of the marketing department.
items.sol: in charge of 意为负责、主管。

items.stem: We should ______ use of the available resources.
items.sol: make use of 意为利用。

items.stem: The manager ______ great emphasis on teamwork.
items.sol: place emphasis on 意为强调。

items.stem: She ______ a great deal of effort into the project.
items.sol: put effort into 意为把精力投入……。

items.stem: The new law will ______ effect next month.
items.sol: take effect 意为生效。

items.stem: He ______ no attention to the warning.
items.sol: pay attention to 意为注意。

items.stem: The company is ______ the verge of bankruptcy.
items.sol: on the verge of 意为濒临……。

items.stem: We must ______ account of the potential risks.
items.sol: take account of 意为考虑到。

items.stem: The two sides finally ______ an agreement.
items.sol: reach an agreement 意为达成协议。

items.stem: I'm ______ favor of the proposal.
items.sol: in favor of 意为赞成。

items.stem: The issue is ______ great importance.
items.sol: be of importance 意为具有重要性。

items.stem: He ______ part in the debate.
items.sol: take part in 意为参加。

items.stem: She is ______ good terms with her colleagues.
items.sol: on good terms with 意为与……关系良好。
